post.summary: Username + password → access and refresh token

get.summary: Current user, locale and Kobo state
Per indexer: searches and grabs left in the rolling 24 hours, and the next free slot
Readers of this server, as Kobo targets for a new book

post.summary: Add a book: owns it right away when the library has it, otherwise starts the paid indexer search. Answers the open request when there is one.

get.summary: The releases the search already found, scored. Free: never searches again.

post.summary: Download this release instead (one grab from the budget, no search)
Try again: a new, paid search round. Answers before the search ends.

get.summary: Search book metadata (Hardcover, Open Library, Google Books). Never spends an indexer search.
Details of one work, with library state
The series a work belongs to, in reading order
Similar books: same series, then same author, then subject. Metadata only.
Every book in the shared library with owners, my Kobo and my reading progress

put.summary: Add a library book to my library, or undo removing it. Cancels a pending deletion.

delete.summary: Remove a book from my library and my Kobo. When nobody owns it any more it is deleted after 7 days.

get.summary: Every reader's Kobo and whether this library book is on it

put.summary: Put the book on a reader's Kobo shelf; that reader becomes an owner. Idempotent.

delete.summary: Take the book off a reader's Kobo shelf. The book stays in the library. Idempotent.

post.summary: Scan the Calibre library for books the broker has no record of, then match books to works in the background. Safe to re-run.

get.summary: Progress of the last library import and the readers books can be assigned to

put.summary: Set who owns each of these books (import review). Replaces the owners; Kobo shelves are left alone.
